category_title: Disengaged EMLLs with antsy behavior and coping through imitation
minimal_context: Shen is sitting at his desk in the general classroom during instructional time to complete his assigned written work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for instructional time. Please look at the assigned work on your desk and begin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly at first and watches the other students, trying to follow their actions.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and read the instructions on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the English words on the page, then becomes antsy and starts shifting around in his seat.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to do the assignment. What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don’t understand, so I won’t do it. (Gets up out of his seat and begins walking around the classroom without permission.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for instructional time. Please look at the assigned work on your desk and begin.

STUDENT: (Sits quietly at first and watches the other students, trying to follow their actions.)

TUTOR: Go ahead and read the instructions on the paper.

STUDENT: (Looks at the English words on the page, then becomes antsy and starts shifting around in his seat.)

TUTOR: You need to do the assignment. What do you think you should do next?

STUDENT: I don’t understand, so I won’t do it. (Gets up out of his seat and begins walking around the classroom without permission.)

task.content: Approaching academic tasks that were not understood due to language barriers
task.learning_goal: Complete the assigned work for today

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When facing language difficulties and not understanding the assigned work
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Frequently 'antsy' and would get up out of his seat and walk around the classroom without permission
related_quotes: I don’t understand, so I won’t do it

behavior_patterns.condition: When he did not know any English during general classroom routines
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Much more quiet than others at first, always followed other students’ actions

behavior_patterns.condition: During independent reading time or PE class
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Really good at just following others and seldom made it wrong
